pairs.ask: Weekly Encrypted Backup Of Every Repo: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Mirror every WebermanApps repo weekly to an encrypted backup outside GitHub, such as Dropbox or an offline drive. Who does it: Security.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Mirror every WebermanApps repo weekly</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">to an encrypted backup outside GitHub,</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">such as Dropbox or an offline drive.</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Who does it: Security.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: If GitHub deletes a repo or a login is taken over, there is no copy of the code outside GitHub.

Why it matters: If</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">GitHub deletes a repo or a login is</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">taken over, there is no copy of the</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">code outside GitHub.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Print Recovery Codes And Keep Them In A Safe: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Print your recovery codes and keep them offline in a safe. Never store them on the shared computer. Who does it: You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Print your recovery codes and keep</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">them offline in a safe. Never store</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">them on the shared computer. Who does</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: If a key or phone is lost without recovery codes, you can be locked out of your own company.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#A3A3A3"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Not Now</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Leave it for now. Why it matters: If a</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">key or phone is lost without recovery</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">codes, you can be locked out of your</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">own company.</text></svg>

pairs.ask: Test-Restore One Repo And One File Each Month: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: In the monthly review, restore one repo and one Dropbox file from backup and check they open. Who does it: Security.

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: A backup nobody has tested may not work when you need it.

pairs.ask: Passkey On The Stripe Account: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Turn on a passkey or hardware key for Stripe before the first real payment, and add Stripe to the 2FA checklist. Who does it: You.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Turn on a passkey or hardware key for</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Stripe before the first real payment,</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">and add Stripe to the 2FA checklist.</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Who does it: You.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Stripe is not on the 2FA checklist yet, but it will hold member payments once smartupkeep.ai launches.

pairs.ask: Card Payments Only Through Stripe Checkout: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Use only Stripe hosted Checkout or Payment Links, with the Stripe portal for billing changes. Card data never touches our pages. Who does it: UpKeep.

visual.svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 240 300" width="240" height="300" style="max-height:100%;max-width:100%"><rect width="240" height="300" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#E5E0D8"/><rect x="0" y="0" width="240" height="8" rx="4" fill="#16a34a"/><text x="18" y="30" font-size="9" fill="#525252" font-family="Hind" font-weight="600">SECURITY</text><text x="18" y="58" font-size="17" fill="#0A0A0A" font-family="Khand" font-weight="700">Do It</text><text x="18" y="108" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Use only Stripe hosted Checkout or</text><text x="18" y="123" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">Payment Links, with the Stripe portal</text><text x="18" y="138" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">for billing changes. Card data never</text><text x="18" y="153" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">touches our pages. Who does it:</text><text x="18" y="168" font-size="10.5" fill="#262626" font-family="Hind" font-weight="400">UpKeep.</text></svg>

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Collecting card numbers in our own forms would make us responsible for card security rules (PCI).

pairs.ask: Two Hardware Keys For Google And GitHub: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Buy two hardware keys (one main, one spare), add them plus a passkey to Google and both GitHub accounts, then turn off SMS fallback. Who does it: You.

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Account takeover is the top way to lose everything. SMS codes can be stolen with a SIM swap or a fake login page.

pairs.ask: Written IP Assignment And NDAs From Helpers: Do It Or Not Now?

optionB.label: Not Now
optionB.desc: Leave it for now. Why it matters: Without a written assignment, contractors can own the code or work they made for you.

optionA.label: Do It
optionA.desc: Agents draft; you approve emails, payments, deletions and pushes to customer sites. Internal dashboards keep publishing on their own. Who does it: All Agents.

pairs.ask: One-Page Breach Plan For Michigan: Do It Or Not Now?

pairs.ask: Collect Only Name, Email, Address And Phone From Members: Do It Or Not Now?

optionA.label: Do It
